newsitem.title: UK: Liberty shares rise after H1 results.
newsitem.headline: Liberty shares rise after H1 results.

text.p: Shares in retail group Liberty Plc rose in early trading on Friday after the company posted a rise in first-half profit and said it was confident progress would accelerate in the second half.
The stock was up 15p at 435 by 0725 GMT.
Liberty said pre-tax profit rose to 1.09 million stg in the six months to July from 0.28 million a year before.
The company said it was making good progress on its restructuring programme and that its first-half results gave confidence for the rest of the year.
Yet one dealer said the rise was about as far as the stock would go on the results.
"We don't see too much further movement in the stock," he said, adding that interest had centred on progress with the retailer's restructuring measures.
Chairman Denis Cassidy the company was confident that the more focused management structure "will produce increasing benefits from our profitable ongoing operations."
